originalTitle: Russell Brand sentenced to 10 years, 6 months for rape and sexual assault

en.title: UK: Russell Brand sentenced to 10 years and 6 months in prison
en.summary: Southwark Crown Court in London on Monday sentenced British actor and comedian Russell Brand to 10 years and 6 months in prison after he was convicted last week of rape and sexual assault offences against 4 women between 2004 and 2009. Brand has said he is innocent.
en.imageAlt: The Southwark Crown Court building in London

ar.title: بريطانيا: الحكم على راسل براند بالسجن 10 سنوات و6 أشهر
ar.summary: قضت محكمة ساوثوارك كراون في لندن يوم الاثنين بسجن الممثل والكوميدي البريطاني راسل براند 10 سنوات و6 أشهر، بعد إدانته الأسبوع الماضي بجرائم اغتصاب واعتداء جنسي بحق 4 نساء بين عامي 2004 و2009. وقال براند إنه بريء.
ar.imageAlt: مبنى محكمة ساوثوارك كراون في لندن

fr.title: Royaume-Uni : Russell Brand condamné à 10 ans et 6 mois de prison
fr.summary: La Southwark Crown Court de Londres a condamné lundi l'acteur et humoriste britannique Russell Brand à 10 ans et 6 mois de prison, après sa condamnation la semaine dernière pour viol et agressions sexuelles commis contre 4 femmes entre 2004 et 2009. Brand affirme être innocent, rapportent France 24 et Al Jazeera.
fr.imageAlt: Le bâtiment de la Southwark Crown Court à Londres

nl.title: VK: Russell Brand veroordeeld tot 10 jaar en 6 maanden cel
nl.summary: De Southwark Crown Court in Londen heeft de Britse acteur en komiek Russell Brand maandag veroordeeld tot 10 jaar en 6 maanden gevangenisstraf, nadat hij vorige week schuldig was bevonden aan verkrachting en aanranding van 4 vrouwen tussen 2004 en 2009. Brand zegt onschuldig te zijn, melden France 24 en Al Jazeera.
nl.imageAlt: Het gebouw van de Southwark Crown Court in Londen

it.title: Regno Unito: Russell Brand condannato a 10 anni e 6 mesi di carcere
it.summary: La Southwark Crown Court di Londra ha condannato lunedì l'attore e comico britannico Russell Brand a 10 anni e 6 mesi di carcere, dopo che la settimana scorsa era stato riconosciuto colpevole di stupro e violenza sessuale nei confronti di 4 donne tra il 2004 e il 2009. Brand si è dichiarato innocente, riferiscono France 24 e Al Jazeera.
it.imageAlt: L'edificio della Southwark Crown Court a Londra

de.title: Großbritannien: Russell Brand zu 10 Jahren und 6 Monaten Haft verurteilt
de.summary: Der Southwark Crown Court in London hat den britischen Schauspieler und Komiker Russell Brand am Montag zu 10 Jahren und 6 Monaten Haft verurteilt, nachdem er vergangene Woche der Vergewaltigung und sexuellen Nötigung von 4 Frauen zwischen 2004 und 2009 schuldig gesprochen worden war. Brand beteuert seine Unschuld, berichten France 24 und Al Jazeera.
de.imageAlt: Das Gebäude des Southwark Crown Court in London

tr.title: İngiltere: Russell Brand'e 10 yıl 6 ay hapis cezası
tr.summary: Londra'daki Southwark Crown Court, geçen hafta 2004 ile 2009 yılları arasında 4 kadına yönelik tecavüz ve cinsel saldırı suçlarından mahkum edilen İngiliz oyuncu ve komedyen Russell Brand'e pazartesi günü 10 yıl 6 ay hapis cezası verdi. Brand masum olduğunu söyledi.

es.title: Reino Unido: Russell Brand, condenado a 10 años y 6 meses de prisión
es.summary: El tribunal Southwark Crown Court de Londres condenó el lunes al actor y humorista británico Russell Brand a 10 años y 6 meses de prisión, después de que la semana pasada fuera declarado culpable de violación y agresiones sexuales contra 4 mujeres entre 2004 y 2009. Brand afirma ser inocente.
es.imageAlt: El edificio del Southwark Crown Court en Londres

body:
Maxkamadda Southwark Crown Court ee magaalada London ayaa Isniintii, 9 November, jilaaga iyo majaajiliistaha Ingiriiska Russell Brand ku xukuntay 10 sano iyo 6 bilood oo xabsi ah. Xukunkan ayaa yimid kadib markii guddi garsoor oo ka kooban 8 nin iyo 4 haween ay Khamiistii hore ku heleen inuu kufsaday hal haweeney, uuna faraxumeyn galmo u geystay saddex kale, intii u dhaxeysay sannadihii 2004 iyo 2009.

Brand, oo 51 jir ah, ayaa lagu helay dembiyada la xiriira afar ka mid ah lix haween oo eedeeyay. Guddiga garsoorka ayaa ku waayay dembi laba eedeymood oo kufsi ah iyo hal eedeyn oo isku day faraxumeyn ah.

## Hadalka garsooraha

Garsoore Joel Bennathan ayaa xukunka markii uu ridayay sheegay in Brand uu ahaa qof ugaarsada haweenka, kaas oo rumaysnaa in caannimadu u oggolaatay inuu sameeyo wax kasta oo uu doono, isagoon ilaalin xeerarka ay ku nool yihiin dadka asluubta leh. Garsooraha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Brand uu muujiyay quursi iyo isla weyni uu u qabay haweenka.

Mid ka mid ah haweenka dhibbanayaasha ah ayaa bayaan ay xeer-ilaaliyayaashu akhriyeen ku sheegtay in dhaawaca nafsiga ah ee ay soo martay uu yahay wax ay maalin kasta la noolaato.

## Difaaca iyo baaritaanno kale

Brand wuxuu ku adkaystay inuu dembi la'aan yahay, isagoo sheegay in xiriirradii oo dhan ay ahaayeen kuwo labada dhinac ku raaceen. Qareenkiisa, Ian Winter, ayaa maxkamadda u sheegay in Brand maanta yahay qof gebi ahaanba ka duwan kii hore, isla markaana uu ka bogsaday ku-tiirsanaanta daroogada iyo khamriga.

Booliiska Magaalada London ayaa sheegay inay baarayaan laba eedeymood oo kale oo kufsi ah, mid ka mid ah oo la xiriirta gabar markaas da'deedu ahayd 16 sano. Madaxa ciidanka booliiska ayaa sheegay inaanu la yaabi doonin haddii dad kale oo badan ay soo baxaan.
verification: Xaqiijin: Al Jazeera (iyo AP) - xukunka, garsooraha Joel Bennathan, guddiga garsoorka, qareenka Ian Winter, baaritaannada booliiska; summary-ga waa la saxay (magac warbaahin laga saaray).
